Correto. Thin skin covers the auricle and though not well shown here, is thicker posteriorly than anteriorly. Fine hairs are present on both surfaces. With aging, especially in men, large stiff hairs may develop around the entrance to the auditory meatus and at the posterior edge of the auricle. Sebaceous glands associated with hair follicles may be of considerable size.
